Privacy.title: Privacy Policy
Privacy.metaDescription: The app primarily processes design files on your device. We do not sell personal information.

introduction.title: Introduction
introduction.content: This policy explains how JigsawDesigner handles information in the app and on this website, including optional cloud features, public sharing, URL-based language selection, and website analytics.

dataCollection.title: Data Collection
dataCollection.content: The app primarily processes design files on your device.
dataCollection.content2: If you enable iCloud, project data may sync through Apple's iCloud and CloudKit services. Publishing sends a selected project to a public CloudKit database, and a share link can provide read-only access to a selected project.

list.behavior: After you actively choose a language, the site stores a necessary language-preference cookie for up to one year. The website uses Google Analytics 4 directly to measure visits and interactions. Under Google's terms, Google may receive analytics identifiers, cookies, and device, browser, and network information. Cloudflare processes request, delivery, and security data needed to operate the site.
list.upload: Third-party media or services, such as a video provider, are contacted only after you choose to load or open that content; their own privacy terms then apply.
list.sell: We do not sell personal information.

analytics.title: Analytics and service providers
analytics.content: Apple may provide opt-in app analytics and crash information under your device settings. This website loads Google Analytics 4 directly to measure website usage. Under Google's terms, Google may receive analytics identifiers, cookies, and device, browser, and network information. Cloudflare hosts and protects the site.

contact.title: Contact Us
contact.content: If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy, please contact us at:

q1.question: Is JigsawDesigner a one-time purchase?
q1.answer: JigsawDesigner provides monthly and yearly Apple subscriptions; Apple shows the current price for your storefront.

q2.question: Can I export my designs for commercial use?
q2.answer: Premium subscribers can export SVG files. Commercial use also depends on the rights to any images, fonts, templates, or other content included in the design.

q3.question: Can I use a custom slot profile?
q3.answer: Yes. Draw or import an open SVG path as the slot profile, then inspect the generated cutlines before exporting.

Help.title: JigsawDesigner Help
Help.metaDescription: Learn how to generate jigsaw cutlines, edit vector shapes, manage projects, and export SVG files with JigsawDesigner.
Help.subtitle: Focused guides for generating puzzle cutlines, editing SVG geometry, managing templates, and organizing projects.

interfaceContent.title: Editor & Cutline Interface
interfaceContent.intro: Use the editor to draw or import a boundary, edit SVG elements, generate puzzle cutlines, and prepare an SVG for downstream use.

toolbar.title: Top Toolbar
toolbar.desc: The toolbar provides quick access to all drawing tools and file operations.

tools.name: Select
tools.desc: Select and move shapes on the canvas

tools.name: Point Edit
tools.desc: Edit anchor points and bezier handles

tools.name: Bezier
tools.desc: Draw bezier curves with control points

buttons.import: Import existing SVG files into your project
buttons.export: Export your design as SVG file
buttons.projectName: Shows current project name and shape count

canvas.title: Project Canvas
canvas.desc: The main workspace where you create your jigsaw puzzle designs.
features: Defined canvas width and height set in the project settings
Ruler display with pixel measurements
Grid overlay for precise alignment
Zoom in/out with scroll wheel or pinch gesture
Pan by dragging with spacebar held or two-finger drag
Selection box shows when element is selected
canvas.tip: Use scroll or pinch to zoom. Pan with a two-finger drag, or hold Space while dragging.

toolsPanel.title: Tools Panel
toolsPanel.desc: The Tools panel provides quick access to common operations and the current tool information.

currentTool.title: Current Tool
currentTool.desc: Shows the currently selected drawing tool and its description.

elementOps.title: Element Operations
elementOps.desc: Copy or delete the currently selected element with one click.

canvasOps.title: Canvas Operations
canvasOps.desc: Reset the view to center, and adjust zoom level using the slider (displayed as percentage).

quickOps.title: Quick Operations
quickOps.desc: Clear the entire canvas, select all shapes, or deselect all with convenient buttons.

layersPanel.title: Layers Panel
layersPanel.desc: Use the Layers panel to view and manage groups and shapes in the SVG hierarchy.
features: View all groups and shapes in a tree structure
Expand groups to see nested items
Lock shapes to prevent accidental edits (lock icon)
Toggle visibility to hide/show elements (eye icon)
Total layer count displayed at the top

templatesPanel.title: Templates Panel
templatesPanel.desc: Slot templates define the shape of puzzle piece connections. This panel lets you manage and create custom templates.
features: Built-in templates: Standard Convex, Standard Concave, Straight Line
Create custom templates by clicking the + button
Search templates by name
Select a template to use it for jigsaw generation
Custom templates are saved to your project

builtin.title: Built-in Templates
builtin.desc: Pre-designed slot shapes provided by JigsawDesigner. Includes classic convex/concave jigsaw tabs.

custom.title: Custom Templates
custom.desc: Design custom slot shapes with the Bezier drawing tools.

inspector.title: Project Inspector
inspector.desc: The right-side inspector shows project or selection settings for the current context.

projectInfo.title: Project Info
projectInfo.desc: View and edit project name, creation date, and modification time.

canvasSettings.title: Canvas Settings
canvasSettings.desc: Set canvas width and height in pixels, or choose from preset sizes (A4, A3, Letter, etc.).

jigsawSettings.title: Jigsaw Settings
jigsawSettings.desc: Configure grid size, target piece count, and slot distance range for puzzle generation.

statistics.title: Statistics
statistics.desc: View shape count, template count, and current zoom level.

operations.title: Project Operations
operations.desc: Access Advanced Settings and the Generate Jigsaw button.

shapeInfo.title: Shape Inspector
shapeInfo.desc: When a shape or group is selected, the right panel shows detailed information about that element.

shapeInfo.title: Shape Info
shapeInfo.desc: View and edit the selected element's name, ID, and type (Path, Group, Circle, etc.).

transform.title: Transform
transform.desc: Adjust position (X, Y), scale, and rotation of the selected element.

geometry.title: Geometry
geometry.desc: View the element's bounding box dimensions and position.

operations.title: Operations
operations.desc: Copy or delete the selected element with one click.

advancedSettings.title: Advanced Settings
advancedSettings.desc: Use Advanced Settings to adjust language, subscription, and editor display options.

language.title: Language Settings
language.desc: Use the system language or choose one of the app's supported languages.

subscription.title: Subscription Management
subscription.desc: View your subscription status and manage your Premium membership.

editor.title: Editor Settings
editor.desc: Customize the canvas display including grid, rulers, snap-to-grid, grid spacing, and stroke width.

templateEditor.title: Template Editor
templateEditor.desc: Create custom slot templates using the built-in bezier curve drawing tool.
features: Name your custom template
Draw bezier curves with click and drag
Double-click to finish the path
Edit individual control points
Import existing SVG templates
Export templates for backup

importSVG.title: Import SVG
importSVG.desc: Import an SVG file as template

projectLibraryContent.title: Project Library
projectLibraryContent.intro: The Project Library is your central hub for managing all jigsaw puzzle designs. Access it from the Welcome screen or via File → Project Library.

myProjects.title: My Projects
myProjects.desc: My Projects stores local project packages and can sync them through iCloud/CloudKit when cloud sync is enabled and available.
features: Local project packages, with optional iCloud/CloudKit sync when enabled and available
Create new projects with the + button
Thumbnail previews with project name and date
Delete projects using the red trash button
Projects marked with cloud icon indicate sync status
myProjects.howTo: Click 'New Project' to create a blank puzzle, or click any existing project thumbnail to open it in the editor.

contextMenu.title: Right-Click Context Menu
contextMenu.desc: Right-click (or long-press on iPad/iPhone) on any project to access these options:

open.title: Open Project
open.desc: Open the project in the editor

publish.title: Publish to Public Projects
publish.desc: Publish the selected project to the Public Projects library so others can import a copy.

share.title: Create Share Link
share.desc: Generate an iCloud link that gives recipients read-only access to the selected project in Shared Projects.

publicProjects.title: Public Projects
publicProjects.desc: Browse projects published to the Public Projects library, preview them, and import a copy to My Projects.
features: Browse projects available in the Public Projects library
View piece count before importing
Click 'Open' to preview the design
Click 'Import' to copy to your My Projects
Use published projects as references for learning
publicProjects.howTo: Select a public project and click 'Import' to add a copy to My Projects. The source project remains unchanged.

sharedProjects.title: Shared Projects
sharedProjects.desc: View projects that other users share with you through iCloud.
features: Receive projects shared by colleagues or friends
Read-only access to shared projects
Updates may appear after iCloud synchronizes the owner's changes
Accept shares via invitation link
sharedProjects.howTo: After you accept a valid share link, the project can appear in Shared Projects for read-only viewing.

1.title: Launch JigsawDesigner
1.desc: Open the application on your Mac or iOS device.

2.title: Choose a Tool
2.desc: Use the eight selection, editing, and drawing tools in the toolbar.

3.title: Draw Your Design
3.desc: Create shapes, paths, or import existing SVG files.

4.title: Generate Jigsaw
4.desc: Click "Generate Jigsaw" to create editable puzzle cutlines inside the boundary.

5.title: Export
5.desc: Export an SVG, then verify its scale, paths, groups, and transforms in the downstream software you plan to use.

select.title: Select Tool
select.desc: Select and move shapes on the canvas. Shift+Click for multi-select, Ctrl+Click to drill into groups.

edit.title: Edit Tool
edit.desc: Edit control points of shapes. Adjust shape geometry precisely by dragging points.

pen.title: Pencil Tool
pen.desc: Draw smooth freehand paths, including open contours that you can continue or join.

rect.title: Rectangle Tool
rect.desc: Draw rectangular shapes. Click and drag from corner to create.

circle.title: Circle Tool
circle.desc: Draw circles and ellipses. Drag from center to set radius.

polygon.title: Polygon Tool
polygon.desc: Draw multi-sided polygons. Click to place each vertex, double-click to finish.

bezier.title: Bezier Tool
bezier.desc: Draw precise Bezier curves with anchor points and control handles.

selection.title: Selection
items: Single Select: Click on any shape
Select All: Press ⌘A to select all shapes
Deep Selection: Ctrl+Click to select child elements in groups

grouping.title: Grouping
items: Group Shapes: Select multiple shapes and press G
Ungroup: Select a group and press ⌘G

editing.title: Editing
items: Copy: Press ⌘C to duplicate selected elements
Delete: Press Delete or Backspace to remove
Transform: Use Inspector panel to adjust position, scale, and rotation

generationContent.title: Jigsaw Cutline Generation Guide
generationContent.desc: JigsawDesigner uses C++ algorithms, including Voronoi and DCEL techniques, to generate customizable jigsaw cutlines. Follow these four steps:

1.title: Import Boundary Contour
1.desc: Import one valid closed outer boundary from SVG, or draw one in the editor.

2.title: Select Slot Template
2.desc: Slot templates define the shape of puzzle piece connections. This panel lets you manage and create custom templates. Built-in templates: Standard Convex, Standard Concave, Straight Line

3.title: Configure Generation Parameters
3.desc: Use the Inspector to set grid size, piece count, and slot-distance range. These parameters affect the density and complexity of the generated cutlines.

4.title: Generate Jigsaw Cutlines
4.desc: Run the generator, inspect the result, and adjust the settings as needed before exporting an SVG.

import.title: Import SVG
import.desc: Import existing SVG files to use as puzzle boundaries or design elements.

export.title: Export SVG
export.desc: The current export format is SVG; keep the .jigsawproject package as the editable project file.
items: Keep the .jigsawproject package for continued editing
Check scale, groups, and transforms in downstream software

premium.title: Premium Feature
premium.desc: New users receive {count} free jigsaw generations. SVG export and unlimited generation require an active Apple subscription.

needHelp.title: Need More Help?
needHelp.desc: Visit the support page for common answers, or contact us with the steps and files needed to reproduce the issue.
